target_customer: Businesses in India that need to book trucks for inter-city freight
problem: Inter-city trucking in India was fragmented, with unclear pricing and no easy way to book and track a truck.
business_model: Marketplace take rate on truck bookings (inferred from the mobile marketplace description; fee model not found)
product_category: Trucking marketplace and logistics in India

founders.name: Sanjay Mandava
founders.background_notes: YC page: proprietary trader and investment analyst at Knight Vinke, and a real estate developer; listed as 2x YC founder.

founders.name: ZJ Lin
founders.background_notes: YC page says co-founder and CPO of GoLorry from 2015 to 2022.

founders.name: J Richards
founders.background_notes: Only initial and surname on the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: A mobile booking marketplace with pricing and tracking is standard app work; the hard part was operations and driver supply in India.

defensibility.rationale: Marketplace liquidity in trucking is hard to build, but no source shows GoLorry reaching it, and several similar Indian startups existed.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent action was found in sources reviewed.

market_need_then: The YC description calls inter-city trucking in India a market needing a mobile marketplace; no dated independent evidence of demand found in the sources reviewed.

branding.domain_note: golorry.com now redirects to a HugeDomains domain sale page, so the company no longer controls it as of 2026.

identity.logo: Plain letter G mark (per a profile site seen in search results)

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand was found, and the domain later went up for sale.

outcome_analysis: GoLorry joined YC in Winter 2016 as an Indian inter-city trucking marketplace and appears to have raised only small amounts reported by aggregators. Its website now redirects to a domain sale page and the YC page says a co-founder was CPO from 2015 to 2022 before starting Landeed, which suggests operations ended around 2022, but no source states a shutdown or the cause, so the cause is not public.
notes: The YC directory lists status Active but the website redirects to a domain sale page; exit type is unknown rather than shutdown because no source states one. Aggregators list a 120K seed from Y Combinator in March 2016 and a 175K seed in 2018 with SGH Capital and Soma Capital (totals 120K to 295K); not recorded as rounds because only aggregators were seen. Competitors left empty: BlackBuck, Rivigo and others appear only in undated directories or a 2018 article, later than the batch window. No outcome source found beyond the YC page and the dead site; searches for news returned nothing about GoLorry. A different company, TheLorry (Malaysia), appears in results and is not this company. Headquarters sources conflict (Hyderabad versus San Mateo).
